amount_notes: Wage subsidy covering up to 100% of minimum wage for non-profit employers. Amount varies by position, hours, and weeks funded.
organization_types_eligible: Small businesses with 50 or fewer full-time employees
eligibility_criteria: Must be a non-profit organization, public sector employer, or small business with 50 or fewer full-time employees
Must hire youth aged 15 to 30 years for summer positions
Positions must provide meaningful skills development for the youth employee
Non-profit employers eligible for up to 100% wage subsidy of provincial minimum wage
exclusions: Organizations that do not comply with applicable federal provincial and territorial legislation
notes: Relevant for pre-launch orgs hiring summer youth staff — coaches, program assistants, admin. Non-profit gets 100% wage subsidy. Annual intake typically November to February for following summer. 2026 intake likely already closed — verify current cycle status before recommending. Stackable with program grants. Not a program grant but reduces operating costs significantly.
